steps.label: Liveness check
WCSPH (validated stable regime with a real y=0 floor boundary)
Effect length 0.6 = one seed spacing, the same pool regime 51/52 use
Pressure coe scale (WCSPHFluid::estimatePressureCoe(0.6, 98.0) = 58.8)
Rest density

Particle radius 0.3, i.e. seed spacing 0.6. This has to divide the pool bounds so that seeds land on x=0/z=0: ScenePreset::BoxDrop's box is only 1x1x1 about the origin, so a pool seeded off those axes (as this scenario's original radius-1.0 / spacing-2.0 pool was) leaves the box's whole drop column empty and the SDF penalty never fires -- see internal design notes 1.7.
Shallow pool, x/z in [-1.2,1.2] (5 seeds each, centred on 0), y in [0,1.2]
Container: floor at y=0 matching the rendered rigid floor, walls just outside the pool, open top
Floor + box dropping from y=3
Precondition: 2 bodies (floor, box)
Enable Rigid-Fluid coupling
One-Way requested (SDF penalty on fluid; box unaffected by fluid reaction, falls to the floor as usual)
Rebuild fluid+rigid+bindings
Precondition: coupling reports enabled
Precondition: effective mode is really One-Way (not silently something else)
Precondition: 5x3x5 seeded pool
Precondition: box starts at drop height
Precondition: pool settles onto the floor and goes quiet while the box is still in free fall well above it (box bottom is at y=1.7 at this point, the pool surface at ~1.0)
Precondition: the pool is nearly at rest just before the box arrives, so anything it does next is the box's doing
Box plunges through the pool down to the floor (~0.6s)
Change: the box actually fell and settled on the floor
Change: the SDF penalty has visibly stirred the pool -- this reads ~0.04 (i.e. still settling quietly) with coupling disabled, see 54_couple_disabled_baseline.json
Invariant: fluid stays bounded (no explosion)

Invariant: fluid rests on the floor. The slop here is wider than the other pool scenarios' +/-0.1 because this samples while the box is still driving particles down into the floor plane (it settles back to ~-0.004 once the box comes to rest, see 54_couple_disabled_baseline.json's own invariant)
Invariant: box (body 1) rests on the floor, unaffected by fluid buoyancy
Invariant: bodies unchanged
Invariant: particle count conserved
